t: 沃尔特·拉利被授予骑士称号,不久后将一个北美地区更名为"维尔吉尼亚"(Virginia),以纪…
te: Walter Raleigh is knighted, shortly after renaming a North American region as "Virginia", in honour of Elizabeth I, Que…
dz: 沃尔特·拉利被授予骑士称号,不久后将一个北美地区更名为"维尔吉尼亚"(Virginia),以纪念英格兰女王伊丽莎白一世,有时被称作"维尔金女王".
de: Walter Raleigh is knighted, shortly after renaming a North American region as "Virginia", in honour of Elizabeth I, Queen of England, sometimes referred to as the "Virgin Queen".

t: 由安德烈亚·帕拉迪奥(Andrea Palladio)设计的奥林匹克剧院在维琴察落成.
te: The Olympic Theatre, designed by Andrea Palladio, is inaugurated in Vicenza.
dz: 由安德烈亚·帕拉迪奥(Andrea Palladio)设计的奥林匹克剧院在维琴察落成.
de: The Olympic Theatre, designed by Andrea Palladio, is inaugurated in Vicenza.

t: 尼莫尔条约废除了对法国新教徒的宽容.
te: The Treaty of Nemours abolishes tolerance to Protestants in France.
dz: 尼莫尔条约废除了对法国新教徒的宽容.
de: The Treaty of Nemours abolishes tolerance to Protestants in France.

t: 丰臣秀吉被正式任命为关白，即辅佐天皇的摄政职位。
te: Toyotomi Hideyoshi is officially appointed kampaku (Imperial Regent).
dz: 丰臣秀吉被正式任命为关白，即辅佐天皇的摄政职位。
de: Toyotomi Hideyoshi is officially appointed kampaku (Imperial Regent).

t: 约翰·戴维斯(John Davis)进入坎伯兰音域以寻找"西北通道".
te: John Davis enters Cumberland Sound in search of the Northwest Passage.
dz: 约翰·戴维斯(John Davis)进入坎伯兰音域以寻找"西北通道".
de: John Davis enters Cumberland Sound in search of the Northwest Passage.

te: The Treaty of Nonsuch signed by Elizabeth I of England and the Dutch Rebels.
dz: 由英国的伊丽莎白一世和荷兰的造反派所签署的"非此类条约".
de: The Treaty of Nonsuch signed by Elizabeth I of England and the Dutch Rebels.

t: 由沃尔特·拉利爵士派遣的由拉尔夫·莱恩(英语:Ralph Lane (New World))负…
te: A first group of colonists sent by Sir Walter Raleigh under the charge of Ralph Lane lands in the New World to create R…
dz: 由沃尔特·拉利爵士派遣的由拉尔夫·莱恩(英语:Ralph Lane (New World))负责的第一批殖民者在今北卡罗来纳州近海的罗阿诺克岛上创建了"罗阿诺克殖民地".
de: A first group of colonists sent by Sir Walter Raleigh under the charge of Ralph Lane lands in the New World to create Roanoke Colony on Roanoke Island, off the coast of present-day North Carolina.

t: 安特卫普围攻：安特卫普被帕尔马公爵亚历山大·法尔内塞领导的西班牙军队占领，他命令新教徒离开这座…
te: Siege of Antwerp: Antwerp is captured by Spanish forces under Alexander Farnese, Duke of Parma, who orders Protestants …
dz: 八十年战争：安特卫普围攻：安特卫普被帕尔马公爵亚历山大·法尔内塞领导的西班牙军队占领，他命令新教徒离开这座城市，结果超过 10 万居民中的一半逃往北部省份。
de: Eighty Years' War: Siege of Antwerp: Antwerp is captured by Spanish forces under Alexander Farnese, Duke of Parma, who orders Protestants to leave the city and as a result over half of the 100,000 inhabitants flee to the northern provinces.
